additional_context: Current R6 source has MessageDefinition active and normative but no active GraphDefinition entries in source/fhir.ini. The conformance roadmap says GraphDefinition is now in the API Incubator, and commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd removed GraphDefinition from fhir.ini and deleted MessageDefinition.graph as part of R6 normative changes. FHIR-I/FMG additional-resources discussions confirm GraphDefinition and $graph moved to API Incubator packaging with external dependency/allowed-target mechanisms.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because restoring MessageDefinition.graph would reintroduce a hard core dependency on a GraphDefinition resource that is outside the current core build.
